headline: A certified operator with a data flywheel underneath it.
thesis: Industrial sectors — construction, facilities, manufacturing, manpower — run on operational data that's usually thrown away. Clarity Group is structured to capture it and act on it, because the Group already runs the physical operations that generate it. Four subsidiaries deploy people and assets on real, certified sites across multiple countries. Two subsidiaries exist to turn what those four do into software and decision-grade intelligence, applied back into the next deployment.
whyNow: A pure software company has no field to deploy insight into. A pure operator has no data layer. Clarity Group has both, under one certified governance standard — and every new site, contract, or country the Group enters adds to the same proprietary dataset the intelligence layer runs on.
